page.layout: One printed page. Full-width italic text at the top (two paragraphs). Below it two columns of governor lists, left column first, then right column. Years in the left margin (1525–1533) and right margin (1534–1541).

p.i: Hi omnes accepti & expensi rationes reddiderunt soli civitati Groningana: & civitas sola fructus Camerae percepit, & in summam eorum vertit, ut ex vetustis rationum indicibus, qui in publicis libris servantur, liceat intelligere.
Post hos, qui secuti sunt per annos xix partim sub Edsardo, partim sub Carolo Geldro, eorum nomina intercíderunt, aut saltem à me reperiri non potuerunt.

page.notes: Right-margin year at the bottom is cut off at the page edge; read as 154 with the last digit unclear. The year 1536 is partly cut off and read with [?]. Groups of names are set as separate lists in the printed columns; the left-hand years mark each group. Governor titles set in capitals are treated as level 3 headings. Scan damage on the left edge and bottom-left corner; the names "Reint Uniets" and "Olde Iohan hornekon" are doubtful. "Gv-BERNATOR" hyphen is printed as shown. Spelling of names kept as printed.
